text:
erica: Quick FYI — we plan to roll a prefetch + soft-quota behavior on the /v1/embeddings ingest path tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Goal: reduce tail latency for small queries while gracefully shedding really large payloads.

sam: Clarify: by "soft-quota" do we mean returning a 413 or auto-splitting client payloads?

erica: Soft-quota = prefer canary split + suggest header to client. We will 1) preflight estimate, 2) if over threshold try async split, 3) if impossible return 413 with helpful guidance. No silent drops.

vik: Telemetry ask: we need pre/post histograms for (a) preflight estimate vs actual tokens, (b) split success rate, (c) latency delta for prefetched requests. Can we tag events with `route=v1/embeddings` and `strategy=prefetch-softquota`?

jules: On console side I want a compact panel: top row shows preflight error rate, split-rate, avg latency small/medium/large. Bottom row shows sample problematic payloads (redact PII). Also we need a rollout toggle UI so SRE/Product can flip strategy to `strict-413` if things go sideways.

erica: Good. Also adding `X-Embed-Units: <estimated-units>` to preflight responses so clients can see cost estimates. We'll accept either `units` or `bytes` hints from clients.

sam: How do we compute units? We discussed dims-first vs bytes-first last week. For heterogeneous arrays, dims-based splitting is unsafe. I propose: if all vectors in request have same dim -> split by dims, else split by bytes.

vik: Agreed. In telemetry include `split_method` tag (`dims` | `bytes`) and `client_hint` (`units`|`bytes`|`none`). We should log both preflight_estimate and final_token_count so we can compute bias.

jules: Console wants example payload guidance to show in 413 message. Something like: "Your request exceeded our soft quota. Consider sending smaller batches or use `X-Embed-Units` hint. See <link> for examples."

erica: I'll add the copy. Also adding a minimal preflight API for SDKs: POST /v1/embeddings:preflight returns `{estimated_units, recommended_split}`. Minimal response example:```json
{"estimated_units": 1280, "recommended_split": "3@250-dims"}
```

sam: Nice. One tricky bit: downstream runtime needs to preserve ordering if we split. Can runtime guarantee original ordering when recombining?

erica: Runtime will stamp `split_id` + `subseq_index` so recombine is deterministic. We'll add a `recombine_latency_ms` telemetry tag.

vik: Perf regression worry: prefetch windows add CPU overhead. Please add an opt-out header `X-Embed-Prefetch: 0` that SDKs can set for high-throughput pipelines. We'll measure CPU/sec per host before/after.

jules: For console rollout plan: staged: 10% traffic -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks at each step (error rate, latency p95, split failure rate). I can wire the toggle to those stages.

erica: Perfect. SRE ask: Have a kill-switch route so we can fallback to `legacy-no-prefetch` variant.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: embeddings-prefetch-v1 -> canary group at 2026-03-31T17:00:00Z by @erica. :rocket:

vik: small UX nit: in console panel, show a sparklines row for 'preflight bias' = (preflight/actual). If bias >> 1.2, our estimator underestimates cost and we should tighten heuristics.

sam: Also include a heatmap of dimension variance per request ID. If variance high, prefer bytes-split.

jules: I'll draft the dashboard and put it in staging under "Embeddings / Prefetch". Link: <https://console.internal/dashboards/draft/embeddings-prefetch> :eyes:

erica: One last API note: error message on 413 should include `retry-after` window and automated snippet for the SDK to auto-chunk. Example snippet to include in docs:```python
# naive chunker
for i in range(0, len(vectors), chunk_size):
    resp = client.embeddings(vectors[i:i+chunk_size])
```

vik: Great. Action items I have: add telemetry tags, add `split_method` and `recombine_latency_ms`, and run a perf load next 24h.

erica: Action items I have: wire preflight response header, add 413 copy, add kill-switch route.

jules: Action items I have: build dashboard draft, add rollout toggle, add canary health alerts.

sam: I'll update SDK to support `X-Embed-Prefetch` opt-out and emit `X-Embed-Units` hints in client calls. Also add automatic chunker helper.

console-bot: Draft dashboard created and shared with @jules, @erica. Permissions: eng-platform, eng-runtime.

erica: Thanks all — we'll sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for readiness check. :thumbsup:
